mapper.select: SELECT t.conversation_id AS conversationId, t.question AS title, t.training_id AS trainingId, t.department_id AS departmentId FROM training_consultation_turn t JOIN (SELECT MIN(id) first_id, MAX(id) last_id FROM training_consultation_turn WHERE owner_id = #{owner} GROUP BY conversation_id) s ON t.id = s.first_id ORDER BY s.last_id DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT id, question, answer AS text, topic, tab_name AS tab, status_name AS status, total FROM training_consultation_turn WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND conversation_id=#{thread}
mapper.select: AND training_id <=> #{training} AND department_id <=> #{department} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_consultation_turn (owner_id, conversation_id, training_id, department_id, question, answer, topic, tab_name, status_name, total) VALUES (#{owner}, #{thread}, #{q.trainingId}, #{q.departmentId}, #{q.question}, #{a.text}, #{a.topic}, #{a.tab}, #{a.status}, #{a.total})
INSERT INTO training_consultation_state (owner_id, conversation_id) VALUES (#{owner}, #{thread}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted=deleted
mapper.select: SELECT deleted FROM training_consultation_state WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND conversation_id=#{thread} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_consultation_state (owner_id, conversation_id, deleted) VALUES (#{owner}, #{thread}, TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted=TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM training_consultation_turn WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND conversation_id=#{thread}
